why: Commits 1 to 5 are specified to the line, but commit 6 says itself that it needs judgement: taking platformModes off ./stripe stops 153 test files' mocks of ./stripe from reaching getStore(), and each test that then behaves differently has to be read and fixed in its setup. Commit 7 is a sequence of about a dozen more cuts across six files, each checked against the walker's figure, with a stop when a call sits in a synchronous function. The lazy imports in commits 1, 3 and 5 change module load order (D440) on the erasure path, the order path and every store page.
harm_if_wrong: A lazy import that changes load order can pass the tests and still give 'Cannot access before initialization' or a 500 on store pages, checkout or account deletion in production; a wrong test setup in commit 6 can hide a payment-mode switch.
make_it_cheaper: Move commit 6 (the Stripe-free platformModes) and commit 7 (the rest of the cycle) into a separate step for the stronger model; commits 1 to 5 plus the docs are then cheap-then-review.
brief_problems: storeObligations() starts at store-closure.ts line 87, not near 83; Row/Tx/Executor are at lines 40-42 and store-features.ts already declares its own copies
docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/import-reach.mjs, which every commit's check runs, is not in the repo yet (step 0.1)
